The '''attempted kidnapping''' of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala]], by members of the [[Burning Rancors]], occurred during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==The attempt==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] discovered that the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] had paid several outlaws on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to kidnap [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala]] before a crucial speech in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. In an effort to draw out the kidnappers, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] hid Amidala in a safe location and allowed her [[Handmaiden/Legends|handmaidens]] [[Sabé/Legends|Sabé]] and [[Eirtaé/Legends|Eirtaé]] to be captured instead.

==Aftermath==
The Council then sent [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] to rescue the Senator. Unaware of the exchange that had occurred, Skywalker successfully tracked down the [[Burning Rancors|kidnappers]] and subdued them. He released Amidala's decoys, but did not like that he was not told the truth about the Jedi Council's plans.
